purpose: Validate a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope while preserving the FARMAKSIA event identity, provenance and safety contract.

activities.label: validate CloudEvents envelopes and map their data to FARMAKSIA
attack envelope identity provenance subject and safety boundaries
record the local compatibility result and adoption limits

queries.expression: does source plus id deduplicate a repeated delivery without changing the event
does the standardized envelope preserve FARMAKSIA entity and provenance fields
are network execution human data and unscoped extensions blocked by the local contract

assumptions: CloudEvents 1.0 supplies a transport envelope, not domain truth.
source plus id identifies one logical event and a retry may reuse it.
FARMAKSIA-specific extensions are namespaced and remain auditable.
A local fixture is sufficient to test contract compatibility before adding a broker or network.
No human data or external side effect is allowed in this experiment.
kill_tests: Missing CloudEvents required attributes blocks processing.
A non-absolute source blocks source identity.
A data event id different from the envelope id blocks mapping.
Missing source version or subject provenance blocks mapping.
A conflicting duplicate source plus id blocks ingestion.
An unscoped extension blocks the envelope.
Enabling network policy blocks the fixture.
unknowns: Which transport will carry events in a real institutional adapter.
Whether a production adapter needs signed CloudEvents or a schema registry.
How external delivery retries and source corrections will be atomically coordinated.
Whether CloudEvents extensions are sufficient for all future claim-level provenance.
